db_dir.description: Directory for storing the main database files (documents, links, etc.)

common_dir.description: Directory for common files (e.g., parsed documents, images)

word_db_dir.description: Directory for the word database (inverted index)

result_dir.description: Directory for storing cached search results

server_url.description: Base URL of the web server (must include trailing slash)

hostname.description: Fully qualified hostname used for absolute URL generation

port.description: Port number of the HTTP server (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)

cgi_url.description: Path (or full URL) to the htdig CGI search script

crawl_limit.description: Maximum number of documents to crawl; 0 = unlimited

crawl_depth.description: Maximum depth to follow links (0 = no limit)

crawl_url_limit.description: Maximum number of URLs to crawl; 0 = unlimited

crawl_delay.description: Seconds to wait between requests to same host (to avoid overloading servers)

max_document_size.description: Maximum document size (KB) to parse; 0 = unlimited

robot_enabled.description: Whether to respect robots.txt and meta tags

start_urls.description: List of starting URLs for the crawler

items.description: A URL to begin crawling from

exclude_urls.description: List of URL patterns (glob-style or regex) to exclude from crawling

require_urls.description: If non-empty, only URLs matching these patterns will be indexed

cgi_extension_filter.description: List of file extensions to include (others ignored); empty = all

ignore_headers.description: List of HTTP headers to skip during indexing

results_per_page.description: Number of search results shown per page

max_matches.description: Maximum number of results to compute and cache (0 = unlimited)

minimum_score.description: Minimum relevance score (0–100) for results to appear

language.description: Language code (e.g., 'en', 'de') for stop-word and stemming rules

stop_words_file.description: Path to a custom stop-words file (one word per line)

word_length_max.description: Maximum length (chars) of a word to index

word_length_min.description: Minimum length (chars) of a word to index

title_indexing.description: Whether to index text inside <title> tags

full_indexing.description: Whether to index full text content

attribute_indexing.description: Whether to index values of HTML attributes (e.g., alt, title)

index_attributes.description: List of HTML attributes to index if attribute_indexing is enabled

proximity_scoring.description: Boost scores for documents with terms in close proximity

title_weight.description: Weight given to title matches (0.0 = ignore title, 1.0 = title only)

search_operator.description: Default logical operator for multi-word queries: 'and' or 'or'

truncation_enabled.description: Automatically append wildcard to partial query terms (e.g., 'run' → 'run*')

stemming_search_enabled.description: Apply stemming to query terms during search
